run_get_coco_zeroshot_oriorder_default: run the script with default paths to restore original COCO category ordering in unseen annotations
run_get_coco_zeroshot_oriorder_custom_pa: run the script with custom --data_path and --cat_path to merge categories into a zero-shot annotation file
build_coco_category_merge: build a pipeline that merges original COCO categories into a zero-shot annotation JSON file
create_coco_oriorder_json: create an original-order COCO annotation JSON by injecting categories from a reference file into an unseen dataset
review_get_coco_zeroshot_oriorder: review the script that loads two COCO JSON files and saves a merged version with original category ordering
